content: Christa le inruoiya nangni naminringjei keengnga, chungtiangnga kaom phurngai kha ningmalungnga entokru, khawakhan Christa in Pathian kutchangtiang in-ong. Minpkla 110:1
Chungtiangnga kaom phurngai sik-ah ningmalungnga ngaidonru, nuoipilchungnga kaom phurngai sik-ah ngaidonmaru.
Ajarchu nangni ningthijei, halli nangni ringkhuo kha Christa le Pathian diang om.
Nangni ringkhuo ka-eii, Christa juo-inlar phakhan, nangni um lurna lianna khan amale ning-inlarsik eii.
Amaruo khat-um Akathar Ringkhuo
Zool-inthai, inthiangmak, taksa imanuom, akathamak nimanuom khat-um kara-ot, ramil chubei katho, nuoipilchung nunchan ka-eii rakip ngaikha nangni diang makheiya minthitaru.
Hiwa ngai jarra, Pathian raangna kha ama chongkajuimak mi ngaidiang ajuosik eii.
Inmani karra ningleiomlai, nangni um aphakhat achu khawa ringkhuo khan ningleiring.
Takkha tuunchu, akaraang, mikathatzoot, miringkhat thamaknasik ka-ngaidon, mi karilse khat-um murra inphut chongkathamak karil, hiwa rakip ngaihi mathaanru.
Akamaruo mikha anunchan le inruoiya nidajei keengnga, inkhatli inkhatdiang maleisei rilkhaimaru Eph 4:22
halli akaboolpa aramil tak-ah singna theina dungjuiya mintharna akathar mi kha ning-inlukjei. Eph 4:24; Inphut 1:26
Khawa jarra, Greek li Jihudi, wun katan li katanmak, ka-am, kamo, suok li suok ka-emak ommakjei, takkha angrakip-ah Christa om, halli Christa kha angrakip eii.
Pathian inakadang inthiang khat-um inaminriang ning-eii jarra, inriang, minriang kajet, nunchan inchuol, malung kadai khat-um kadei karaat hiwa ngaihin ningpum ngaikha insuunru. Eph 4:2
Inkhat li inkhat inzootnaru halli miringkhat chungnga miring inkhat in kahoimak angjet ngaikha in-ngaidamru. Pumi'n nangni ina-ngaidam angnga nangni innum in-ngaidamru. Eph 4:32
Halli hiwa ngai rakip pui katungnga kakhuopchun inriang hi neiru.
Christa diangnga kahoi kadai khan ningmalung ngaikhan wai roonrase, pumkhatbit taksa ngai ning-eii jarra nangni hi kahoi kadai sik-ak inakoi kha ning-eii. Halli nangni'n rokru.

Nangni'n lungsing lungwar rakip-ah inkhatli inkhat inchu indikru, nangni minpaak laa, rokpuina laa khat-um ratha laa khan Pathian diang ningmalung karok-ah sakru, Christa chongkha nangni diang insam omlekleiya omrase.
Halli ning-itho rakip, chuonna emakli chongnga, angrakip kha ama diangnga inphut Pa Pathian kha minpaak inlang Pumi Jisu ramingnga thoru. Eph 5:19,20
Christian Insuungkhur Sisikdan
Pumi diang rahoi ka-eii angnga, inkaneijei numeisa ngai ningruothar ngai nuoiya omru. Eph 5:22; 1 Pet 3:1
Pakhat ngai, ningnumei ngai minriangru halli inmani chungnga kese-ah thomaru. Eph 5:25; 1 Pet 3:7
Sangai, ang rakip-ah ningnu ningpa chong juiru, ajarchu hiwahi Pumi imanuon kha eii. Eph 6:1
Nu li pa ngai, ningsa ngai malung kahoimak suokmanasik inmani raangnasik chuon thomaru. Eph 6:4

Suokngai, ningkaru ngai'n na-enphabit khat-um inmani'n naminriangnasik elekleiya; takkha Pumi ningchile inruoiya ningmalung kaluut-ah angrakip-ah nuoipilchungnga kaom ningkaru ngaikha juiru. Eph 6:5-8
Ning-itho rakip-ah, mi sik-ah kitho emak Pumi sik-ah kitho eii ngaidon inlang, ningmalung pumpuiya thoru.
Pumi Christa kha eii sepa nitho. Ama mi ngai sik-ah idajei chuonthoman kha Pumi diangnga inphut ningmusik eii itihi ngaidonru.
Akadikmak akatho ama khan adikmakna kha amusik eii, ajarchu khawa khan mimeel mimai ensik ommak. Innidan 10:17; Eph 6:9
